author: Glasgow123
body:
I used to hack... I regret that now... 2 years ago... I logged onto my favourite server... Avicus... At the time it was thewallsmc.eu ... I played nebula every day... Recked nubs... As time passed by I grew more and more frustrated at hackers... TO be point where... I hack to kill them... I installed a client and killed them all... 2 days later.. I was banned... I didnt think much of it at the time... but as time has passed by I have grown to miss the server... My username Is :Glasgow123 , and all i want is a second chance ... I know know my actions where wrong. I own a youtube channel and would love to make vids on avicus... Please all I want is a second chance.
- Thank you- Name: Gary : Minecraft Username: Glasgow123
